WELCOME_LINES: Your team's skills live in one private git repository the team controls; each member installs what they want, edits flow back on sync, and the team endorses the ones everyone should have.

BASICS_COPY.Manage: Your Library lists every skill the team shares. Turn one on to load it into every session; the heart marks the ones you rely on.
BASICS_COPY.Eval: An eval runs a skill against your team's catalog; with --commit its receipt lands in the team repository, and every card's verdict and net lift are read from there.
BASICS_COPY.Share: Share a skill you wrote and it lands in the team repository. Teammates install it with one line, and the line travels with the skill.
BASICS_COPY.Search: ⌘K finds skills, people and projects across the team. The Marketplace is the same search with filters and the team's picks.
BASICS_COPY.More to come: Three things the sharing spec defers until the basics prove themselves. Ask for what you need under Feedback and requests.
